name: routepilot.pro
description: Multi-tenant pool-service SaaS: scheduling, live routing, billing, a branded customer portal, and an offline field app for techs

paragraphs: All-in-one software for pool service companies: route optimization, AI-assisted chemistry, automated billing, an offline field app for technicians, and a branded customer website and portal — for businesses that have outgrown spreadsheets and text threads.
features: A customer website and portal per company — a branded public site built from a

live-preview page builder, plus a portal where homeowners see when their tech is coming, how their water looked on the last visit, photos, their bill, and the services they get. They can add, pause, or stop a service…
Smart routing and live operations — pack more stops into fewer miles, then watch the day
live: pending, in-progress, and completed stops across every truck on one map. Drag a stop to hand it to another tech.
AI chemistry — reads 12-visit trends and the 7-day forecast and tells the tech exactly what
